timeline.title: Research Intern (Master's Thesis)
timeline.company: School of Computing, National University of Singapore
timeline.summary: Generative modeling of mixed-type tabular data, where the hard part is that numbers and categories don't live in the same space. My thesis builds an XGBoost-based variational flow-matching framework for it, which takes the best overall average rank against 12 neural and tree-based generators.

timeline.title: Research Scientist Intern
timeline.summary: Product search for when the query is a conversation rather than a keyword — an LLM pulls apart attributes, compares candidates and re-ranks, post-trained with reinforcement learning on a composite relevance-and-engagement reward.

timeline.title: Research Intern
timeline.summary: Data, Knowledge and Intelligence group. Built ForestLLM, which uses a language model as an offline forest designer at training time so that nothing has to call it at inference.

timeline.title: Applied Scientist
timeline.summary: Video recommendation and K-12 mathematical reasoning, in production — feature engineering, fine-tuning and inference optimization, on models that had to hold up in front of real users.

timeline.title: Research Engineer Intern
timeline.summary: Uncertainty-based image-quality assessment for industrial surface-defect detection, plus multimodal data synthesis to make up for how few defect samples a real production line ever produces.
